$schema_description: WebPT Assessment Checklist Template. Import this format into WebPT to add custom checklists.
name: Custom Pentest Assessment Template
description: Template checklist demonstrating all supported fields including MITRE ATT&CK tactics, CWE, CVSS, test cases, recommendations, and parameterized command scripts.

items.name: Service Discovery and Port Enumeration
mitre_technique: T1595.001 - Active Scanning: Scanning IP Blocks
items.how: Perform port scanning and service banner grabbing against target IP/host to identify open ports, running services, and version information.
cases: Run TCP SYN port scan across standard ports (1-10000)
Perform service version detection (-sV) and default script scanning (-sC)
Identify unintended exposed management interfaces (SSH, RDP, Redis, Elasticsearch)
items.expected: Only required public ports are accessible. Administrative interfaces are filtered or behind VPN. Service versions do not leak unnecessary internal details.
items.recommendation: Restrict firewall rules to expose only necessary services. Place administrative services behind a VPN or IP whitelist. Disable service banner version disclosures.

items.name: SQL Injection in Query / Body Parameters
items.how: Inject single quotes, boolean operators, time-delay payloads, and union payloads into all query and body parameters to test for SQL injection flaws.
cases: Test single quote and syntax breaks: ' OR '1'='1 --
Test boolean differential responses: AND 1=1 vs AND 1=2
Test time-based blind injection: WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5' or pg_sleep(5)
items.expected: Application uses parameterized queries / prepared statements for all database interactions. No SQL syntax errors or data exfiltration occurs.
items.recommendation: Use parameterized queries (PreparedStatements / ORMs) for all database operations. Implement input validation and least-privilege database user permissions.
